name: Srebarna Nature Reserve
description: Srebarna is a shallow freshwater lake in northeastern Bulgaria, just south of the Danube and about 18 km west of Silistra. Its reed beds and waters shelter nearly 100 breeding bird species, including Dalmatian pelicans, spoonbills, glossy ibis and several herons. Lying on a major Europe–Africa migration route, it also hosts some 80 more species each winter. A small museum on site displays local wildlife.
